summary: Without --project, tally now ends with a total line summing every project.
Why: a timesheet needs one billable/reportable grand total after the per-project rows.
What you notice: site and docs lines, then total 4h15m; --project site still prints only that project.

blocks.caption: Acceptance run: all-projects ends with total 4h15m; --project site has no total line

blocks.title: Where the grand total is printed
blocks.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  parse[Parse timesheet] --> flag{--project set?}
  flag -->|yes| one[ProjectTotal + print one line]
  flag -->|no| many[Totals + print each project]
  many --> grand[GrandTotal + print total line]
  one --> done[exit 0]
  grand --> done

focus.title: GrandTotal lives in internal/tally
focus.detail: Summing stays out of main; GrandTotal returns Total{Project: "total", ...} so the same Fprintf as ProjectTotal works.

focus.title: --project omits the grand total
focus.detail: Only the all-projects branch appends the total line; the single-project path returns after one row.

inline.files/acceptance.txt:
=== without --project ===
site                 3h30m
docs                 0h45m
total                4h15m
exit=0

=== with --project site ===

exit=0
